# FAQ-003 Engineering FAQ #3
Revision: Rev A

Q1: What is the thermocouple calibration interval for EQ-P2-L4-HT02 (Heat Treat heat treat furnace #2)?
A1: The thermocouple calibration interval for EQ-P2-L4-HT02 is 55 days. Schedule and record calibrations per SOP-P2-L4-01.

Q2: What is the coil cooling water flow minimum for EQ-P1-L2-IH02 (Ring Rolling induction billet heater #2)?
A2: The coil cooling water flow minimum for EQ-P1-L2-IH02 is 46 L/min. Verify flow at the inlet sensor during startup and after any maintenance that affects the cooling circuit.

Q3: What lubricant part number should be used on EQ-P2-L4-HP03 (Heat Treat hydraulic forging press #3)?
A3: Use lubricant part number CFW-LUB-450 for EQ-P2-L4-HP03. Follow the lubricant change and inspection procedures in MM-P2-L4-HT02 and SOP-P2-L4-01.

Q4: What is the mandrel clamp bolt torque for EQ-P3-L4-RR01 (Heat Treat radial ring rolling mill #1)?
A4: The mandrel clamp bolt torque for EQ-P3-L4-RR01 is 605 N·m. Apply torque using a calibrated wrench and log the torque application in the maintenance record referenced by SB-1048.

Q5: What is the coil cooling water flow minimum for EQ-P2-L2-IH01 (Ring Rolling induction billet heater #1)?
A5: The coil cooling water flow minimum for EQ-P2-L2-IH01 is 81 L/min. Confirm flow during preheat and document any deviations per SOP-P2-L4-01.

Related documents:
- MM-P2-L4-HT02
- SB-1048
- SOP-P2-L4-01
